description: Electron-builder on macOS signs non-Windows native `.node` prebuilds and osslsigncode rejects them, based on https://github.com/electron-userland/electron-builder/issues/7652.
prompt:
My macOS CI signs the Windows Electron build after we upgraded electron-builder from 23.6.0 to 24.4.0. It now walks into native prebuild folders and blows up on Linux and Darwin `.node` files.

Unrecognized file type: dist_electron/win-unpacked/resources/app.asar.unpacked/node_modules/utf-8-validate/prebuilds/linux-x64/node.napi.node
